correctness.rationale: The exact pair-count cap at two is justified by excluding at most one matched blinking neighbor. Monotonicity of occupied-type support proves that recurrence of the quotient is exactly first recurrence of the labelled dynamics, with the full period given by an induced permutation order. Standalone Python certificate exhaustively enumerates all 19683 quotient states with complete transition, 33 recurrent quotient cycles, periods and sharp first-entry bounds for every n. An independent integer-polynomial program verifies the full period-four EGF identity, and independent C++ vertex-level exhaustive enumeration for n=2..7 covers 5380830 labelled initial states; all sources and execution outputs are included. The finite quotient, not small-size sampling, is the all-n proof. For n=3 the 24 quotient templates each contribute 3! assignments, 72 recurrent phase configurations, and exactly four primitive eighteen-cycles.

originality.rationale: Materially inspected the author-uploaded full 2014 firefly manuscript: its Definition 1 matches the update used here, but its principal theorems concern paths, trees, and stochastic edge/vertex perturbations, not exact crown-graph period basins. The 2016 work concerns trees; its abstract was available but full text not material to this graph family. Previously reported comparators on complete bipartite and complete split graphs use the same local update on different neighborhoods, so their exact formulas cannot imply those for matched-deleted graphs. Own crown-graph results use cyclic cellular automata or Greenberg–Hastings excitation, distinct transition rules. Published-record and external aliases/parameter searches did not disclose the present thirteen-step bound, three-pair eighteen-cycle exception, or exact period-four polynomial. These observations support originality to the extent of inspected evidence, not a claim of global absence.

value.rationale: Complete dynamical classification of a natural infinite family of dense but non-complete bipartite graphs. The sharp thirteen-update uniform transient bound, the isolated n=3 primitive eighteen-cycle exception, and an exact infinite-family attraction-basin polynomial (with exponential predominance of the three-cycle class) are motivated invariants of pulse-coupled synchronization. These outcomes expose the effect of deleting a matching and are not a routine graph-size substitution or a census of a single arbitrary small graph.
